content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD Module MOD_FOAM (whole file inside # if defined (FOAM), L1/L542): surface foam layer transport driven by wave breaking. Module data (L11-36): foam thickness EtaFoam, its running max EtaFoamMax, foam-layer velocities UFoam/VFoam, surface fields Usurf/Vsurf and breaking-age field VFsurf plus staged copies (Usurf1/2 etc.), face fluxes MxFoam/MyFoam and unused FxFoam/FyFoam/GxFoam/GyFoam, sink/source arrays SinkM/SourceM, MaskFoam, and tunables with inline defaults: BurstRate=0.01_SP (L12), MinThick=0.01_SP (L15), TransferRate=0.1_SP (L16), CdFoam=0.5 (L17), f_source=0.05 (L29), FoamTimeScale=3.8 (L30), BurstTimeNonBreaking=1.0 (L31), OUT_FOAM=.FALSE. (L33), PARAMETER SMALL=0.000001_SP (L36). ALLOCATE_FOAM (L40-55) allocates cell-centered (Mloc,Nloc) and face (Mloc1/Nloc1) arrays. INITIALIZATION_FOAM (L57-272) reads from input.txt via READ_FLOAT with defaults and unit-3 logging: PLOT_INTV_FOAM (L77, defaults to PLOT_INTV L84), BurstRate (L98, only under USE_BURSTRATE, default 0.01 L100), f_source (L121, default 0.05 L123), FoamTimeScale (L141, default 3.8 L143), BurstTimeNonBreaking (L161, default 1.0 L163), MinThick (L183, default 0.01 L185), TransferRate (L204, USE_BURSTRATE only, default 0.1 L206), CdFoam (L227, default 0.5 L229); then zero-initializes all foam arrays and MaskFoam=1 (L249-270). FOAM_UPDATE (L274-367): copies Usurf=U, Vsurf=V, VFsurf=AGE_breaking (L280-282). Source/sink: old USE_BURSTRATE approach (L285-294) sets VFsurf=1000 where age<0.1 then VFsurf=0.4*EXP(-VFsurf) (L289-290), SinkM=EtaFoam*BurstRate (L291), SourceM=VFsurf*TransferRate*MaskFoam (L292); new approach citing Reul and Chapron 2003 (L296-312): where age < 2*DT reset VFsurf=LARGE and EtaFoamMax=0 (L300-303), in non-breaking zones (nu_break==ZERO) VFsurf=BurstTimeNonBreaking (L305-307), track EtaFoamMax (L308), SinkM=EtaFoam/FoamTimeScale*EXP(-VFsurf/FoamTimeScale) (L309), SourceM=f_source*nu_break*MaskFoam (L310). Continuity update over interior cells (L321-339): EtaFoam -= DT*(flux divergence of MxFoam,MyFoam)/DX,DY - SinkM*DT + SourceM*DT (CARTESIAN L325-328, curvilinear L330-333), clipped non-negative (L336). Momentum update (L346-365): where EtaFoam>0, relative-velocity drag Uabs=|Usurf-UFoam| vector norm (L350), Uadd/Vadd = Uabs*(Usurf-UFoam)*CdFoam/MAX(EtaFoam,MinThick)*DT (L351-352) with overshoot limiter replacing Uadd by Usurf when |Uadd|>|Usurf-UFoam| (L354-355), UFoam+=Uadd (L357-358); else foam velocity zeroed (L361-362). FOAM_BC (L369-433): zeroes Mxfoam/EtaFoam on west (L378-381), east (L392-395), Myfoam/EtaFoam on south (L406-409), north (L418-421) physical boundaries (guarded by n_west etc. == MPI_PROC_NULL under PARALLEL), then phi_exch of EtaFoam/UFoam/VFoam (L427-429). FOAM_FLUX (L435-492): builds first-order upwind face fluxes by MUSCL reconstruction: DelxFun+CONSTRUCT_X of EtaFoam gives VxL/VxR, upwind select by sign of face-averaged UFoam into MxFoam (L443-453), then reconstructs UFoam and multiplies into MxFoam (L454-464) so MxFoam = upwinded(EtaFoam)*upwinded(UFoam); same for MyFoam with DelyFun/CONSTRUCT_Y and VFoam (L467-488). UPDATE_FOAM_MASK (L494-538, marked 'useless so far' L494): wetting - unmasked cell becomes active if any neighbor is active and its EtaFoam exceeds the cell by MinThick (L502-526); drying - active cell with EtaFoam<MinThick is deactivated and zeroed (L528-533).
entities: SUBROUTINE INITIALIZATION_FOAM (L57), locals I,J,K (L67), FILE_NAME/TMP_NAME (L69-70), Ifile,ierr (L71)
SUBROUTINE FOAM_FLUX (L435), locals VxL,VxR (L437), VyL,VyR (L438), DelX,DelY (L439), I,J,K (L440)

foam production from breaking eddy viscosity
foam thickness continuity, CARTESIAN, continued L326-328 with -SinkM*DT +SourceM*DT; curvilinear L330-333
flux = upwinded thickness times upwinded velocity

verbatim_spans.text: ! new approach using Reul and Chapron 2003
DO J=1,Nloc   ! previous J=2,Nloc-1, not consistent with the y direction

unresolved: myid is referenced in PARALLEL branches of INITIALIZATION_FOAM (L80, L87, L102, ...) but no USE GLOBAL list in this module imports myid (module-level L3-8 or subroutine-level L59-61); how it resolves under PARALLEL compilation is external to this file.
Cross-line: the module-level SMALL PARAMETER (L36) is shadowed in INITIALIZATION_FOAM by USE GLOBAL,ONLY : ... SMALL (L59); neither is actually used in that subroutine.

Cross-line: the x-direction upwind test uses >ZERO in the thickness pass (L447) but >0 in the velocity pass (L458); the y-direction uses >ZERO in both (L471, L482). Comment L445 also records a previous loop-range inconsistency between x and y directions.

FxFoam/FyFoam/GxFoam/GyFoam are allocated and zeroed (L45-47, L256-259) but never used elsewhere in this file; Usurf1/2, Vsurf1/2, VFsurf1/2, DepthFoam likewise only initialized (L262-267, L50-53). EtaFoamMax is tracked (L302, L308) but never output or read here.
UPDATE_FOAM_MASK is annotated 'useless so far' (L494) and its locals left/right/top/bottom (L496) are unused; whether it is called from elsewhere is outside this file.
OUT_FOAM (L33) and PLOT_INTV_FOAM/PLOT_COUNT_FOAM (L11, L76-91) are set up but no output subroutine exists in this module; the writer of foam fields is external.

Overshoot limiter sets Uadd=Usurf(I,J) (not Usurf-UFoam) when the drag increment exceeds the velocity difference (L354-355); whether the intended limit is the difference is not determinable from this file.
iista/jjsta imported under PARALLEL (L61) and itmp1-itmp5 (L59) are unused in this file.
